obs: "And reasonable cause they must be considered to have had when such a state of facts was brought to their notice ... as would have led prudent business men to the conclusion that they could not meet their obligations as they matured in the ordinary course of business."

“Giving such a broad sweep to 455(a) seems contrary to the reasonable person standard which it embraces. I think that an objective observer, informed of these facts, would not conclude that my participation … gives rise to an appearance of partiality.”
“Although reason to believe is an objective standard, it is by no means clear that certain objective characteristics of the infringer such as age may not be taken into account.”
